location.ref: Sundar Vilās, savaiyās on the mind

paraphrase: The mind is a thief, a monkey, a mad elephant; it runs after the senses and makes a fool of the wise; only the guru's word and constant discrimination bring it under control.
speaker: Sundardās
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
notes: Skeleton from memory (Phase B). Topic-level summary.
